follow_ups.title: CreateOrderAsync returns 200 when the order command fails or is rejected by the domain
follow_ups.reason: The failure is only logged and the client still gets 200; tracked by BUG-9, and the propagated OrderingDomainException is currently caught to keep that behavior.

follow_ups.title: Ignore nested graphify-out folders in .gitignore
follow_ups.reason: The graphify ignore rules only cover the repository-root graphify-out/, so running graphify from a subdirectory creates output that can be committed; the factory owns .gitignore, so the implementer cannot add the rule.

follow_ups.title: Factory guard blocks git commit for the implementer
follow_ups.reason: Every git commit was refused, including a plain one-line commit, so review fixes depend on the runner's automatic commit.
